dedupe_keys.name: variable structure control of a small ducted wind turbine in the whole wind speed range using a luenberger observer

description: Diego Calabrese and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. Two components support the cited small ducted horizontal-axis turbine control study. CSV files contain measurements from an experimental laboratory emulator, and an Excel workbook contains aerodynamic characteristics of the selected turbine. The source establishes these as observations and model-input characteristics, not as measurements from an operating wind farm. It does not state the sampling interval, experiment duration or complete column schema. The data support the documented variable-structure controller evaluation, while the paper and any controller implementation retain separate roles. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
